title: Automations: the five screens you sent back, redone

steps.path: Pages → Automations → a card → Add a permission
steps.headline: The Add menu is as wide as its button again.
steps.changed: You asked why it got narrower: its width followed its longest row, and the rows had got shorter. It now always matches the button. The folder rows say what they do: See the files in a folder… and Change the files in a folder….
steps.notice: Nothing else about the menu changed.

steps.path: Pages → Automations → a card → Add a permission → See the files in a folder…
steps.headline: A folder is chosen with the same folder chooser Page settings uses.
steps.changed: The typed box and the See / See and change switch are gone. This is the Choose folder… box from Page settings → Files. Choosing a folder in your computer's own window adds the permission at once. The × on the label line cancels.
steps.notice: No typing a folder path, and no separate Add button.
steps.risk: On a phone the folder window cannot open, so the box says to choose it on your computer, as Page settings does.

steps.path: Pages → Automations → a card → Add a permission → Run a command…
steps.headline: A command is one box with Add inside it.
steps.changed: Two fields, a hint and two buttons became one field. Add sits inside the box, the way other text fields with one action do in the app, and × on the label line cancels. A website looks the same, with its address in the box.
steps.notice: A command you type yourself is listed as Run a command with the command under it. Only permissions the assistant writes get a name in plain words.
steps.risk: The note that * covers any part that changes is gone from the screen. It would live in the (i) by the page title.

steps.path: Pages → Automations → a card → Add a permission → Describe it…
steps.headline: Describe it: Write it sits inside the box, × on the label line.
steps.changed: As you suggested: the Write it button is inside the text box and the × is at the top right, in line with What it may do. Cancel is gone as a separate button.
steps.risk: The box is one line now, so a long description scrolls sideways.

steps.path: Pages → Automations → a card → Add a permission → Describe it… → Write it
steps.headline: What the assistant wrote looks like the permission line it will become.
steps.changed: The box-inside-a-box and three buttons became one line drawn like every other permission: the name, the command under it, and Edit and Add where a line's Always allowed pill sits. × cancels.
steps.notice: Add turns it into a normal line set to Asks first.
steps.risk: In this practice version the answer is always the same sample.

steps.headline: Runs per day is its own box, with the dropdown you can also type in.
steps.changed: It moved out of the Schedule box, where it read as part of Button text, into its own labelled box under it. The control is the one Assistant settings → Step guard uses: pick No limit, 5, 10, 20, 50 or 100, or type your own number.
steps.notice: Still shown only for jobs started by a button or an event.
steps.risk: The closed box shows just the number (20).
